English: Chapter-3 Power, Functions and Duties of the Commission Power, Functions and Duties of the Commission: The power, function and duties of the Commission shall be as follows: to conduct study national policy and programs for the promotion and protection of the rights and interests of the indigenous nationalities community and the empowerment of such community and to make recommendation to the Government of Nepal for their implementation, to conduct study and research on whether the provisions and arrangements made for the promotion and protection of the rights and interests of the indigenous nationalities community and their empowerment have been effectively implemented, and to make suggestions to the Government of Nepal for the measures to be taken for their effective implementation, to make suggestions to the Government of Nepal regarding the reforms in terms of legal, policy and institutional measures, required for the promotion and protection of the rights and interests of the indigenous nationalities community and the empowerment of such community, toreview, monitor and evaluate the implementation of the policy and programs related to indigenous nationalities community, to monitor or cause to be monitored the implementation of the recommendations made or suggestions given by the Commission, to make recommendations to the Government of Nepal for the formulation and implementation of special programs for the development and empowerment of economically or socially indigent people within the indigenous nationalities community, to undertake studies and research into the language, script, culture, history, tradition, literature, art within the indigenous nationalities communities, and to make recommendations to the Government of Nepal for the protection and development of such language, script, culture, history, tradition, literature, art of such communities, to conduct awareness generating program for the protection and promotion of the rights and interests of the indigenous nationalities communities and the empowerment of such communities, to formulate programs to end existing malpractices, superstitions and all forms of exploitation existing within the indigenous nationalities communities and the empowerment of such community and to make recommendations to the Government of Nepal, to protect and promote the traditional skill, technology and special knowledge existing within the indigenous nationalities communities and to assist in its application for commercial use, to monitor the implementation of the international treaties, agreements relating to the indigenous nationalities communities that Nepal is a party to, and to make recommendations or suggestions to the Government of Nepal for their implementation,to collect complaints against the persons or organizations that violate the rights of the indigenous nationalities communities and to make recommendation to the concerned agency to conduct investigation and prosecution over such complaints, to identify the indigenous nationalities communities by means of detailed studies and research and to make recommendations to the Government of Nepal to make lists of Surnames, to formulate policy and programs to establish and mobilize living museum for the protection and promotion of the physical, non-physical culture of the indigenous nationalities communities and to make recommendations to the Government of Nepal for their implementation, to search for and investigate the place of origin of the indigenous nationalities communities and to make recommendations to the Government of Nepal for the protection and promotion of those archaeological and ancient structures, objects and places, to review, monitor and evaluate the awareness generating programs conducted by the Government of Nepal and other organizations and institutions for the protection, promotion and empowerment of the indigenous nationalities communities, to formulate and implement the code of conduct for the Chairperson, Members and employees of the Commission, to approve the annual plans and program of the Commission
